component.name: Ghost Controller
component.summary: Native UAV ground control station for Linux

description.p: Ghost Controller is a native ground control station for UAVs, built with PySide6 + Qt Quick (QML) and running the proven MAVLink backend in-process. It is the native desktop port of the Ghost Handler web GCS HUD.

Features include a full-bleed video HUD with pitch ladder and tapes, a heading / roll / pitch readout, a map screen with offline tiles and image overlay, a mission planner with waypoints / fence / survey / orbit tools, parameter editing with staged writes, video source selection (RTP / RTSP / MJPEG), battery setup, and firmware-aware mode selection for PX4 and ArduPilot vehicles.

The app never fabricates a vehicle link: without a real MAVLink heartbeat it stays DISCONNECTED and shows the configured listening address. Launch with --sim for a simulated demo that cannot be mistaken for a live vehicle.
